# Disagreement Log — T12_007 (Testament of Dan)
**Chapter:** T12_007 | **Verses:** 7 sections (~13 verses)
**Translators compared:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA | **Arbiter:** SOPHIA

| # | Verse | Issue | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | SOPHIA ruling |
|---|-------|-------|------|-------|--------|---------------|
| 1 | 1:3 | Cause of sin identification | "they-taught-me concerning-them the-spirit-of-lies" | "they teach men the way of lying and of anger unto blood" | "because they almost destroyed me" (paraphrase) | LOGOS more precise — lying and anger "teach" the way; SOPHIA follows LOGOS |
| 2 | 2:3 | List of relational blindness | Full list with parallel structure | Same parallel structure | Compressed into summary | EMET/LOGOS parallel list retained — it is a rhetorical climax, not mere repetition |
| 3 | 3:4–5 | Twofold/threefold power analysis | Technical philosophical analysis | Same | Simplified into one sentence | EMET/LOGOS technical analysis retained — this is a distinctive psychological taxonomy |
| 4 | 5:3 | "Saviour of the nations" | Present | Present | "the Savior of the nations" | All three agree; "Savior of the nations" unanimous — Messianic title |
| 5 | 6:3–7:2 | Eschatological section | EMET has extended oracle | LOGOS has gathering/return section | PNEUMA abbreviates | SOPHIA combines: scattering prediction + return promise + Beliar-war ending — the full arc |

---
*SOPHIA notes: Testament of Dan is the anger treatise. The psychological analysis of how anger escalates from provocation to murder (4:1–5) is one of the most sophisticated moral-psychology passages in the corpus. All three translators preserve it, though PNEUMA softens the technical analysis into narrative. The "Savior of the nations" title in 5:3 is another Messianic insertion — unanimous across translators.*
